question: Should OpenClaw ship Swedish as a supported Control UI locale with the current 880 translated keys and 537 tracked English fallbacks after the branch conflicts are resolved?
rationale: The implementation path is sound, but whether that fallback level meets the supported-locale quality bar is a maintainer content decision rather than a mechanical code review result.

options.title: Resolve and accept this first Swedish pass
options.body: Refresh the branch against current main, preserve the Swedish generator label, rerun focused i18n checks, and merge with the tracked fallback metadata as intentional.

options.title: Pause for fuller Swedish coverage
options.body: Ask for another generated or reviewed translation pass before advertising Swedish as supported.

options.title: Close or supersede with a maintainer-owned locale pass
options.body: Use a maintainer-owned branch if the conflict and generated-output refresh should be handled centrally.

recommendation.title: Resolve and accept this first Swedish pass
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch against current main, preserve the Swedish generator label, rerun focused i18n checks, and merge with the tracked fallback metadata as intentional.
